readme: # MultiFingerGestureX An LSPosed/Xposed module that adds 3+ finger gesture support to Android 15+. 为一加平板添加三指以上手势支持。傻逼OPPO连多指Home/Recents手势都没有。傻逼OPPO傻逼OPPO傻逼OPPO傻逼OPPO傻逼OPPO傻逼OPPO ## What It Does Put three or more fingers on the screen: | Gesture | Action | |---------|--------| | Short Tap | Back | | Swipe Down | Screenshot | | Swipe Up | Home (fast) / Recents (slow) | | Swipe Left / Right | Switch to previous / next app | 三指或更多手指在屏幕上操作： | 手势 | 效果 | |------|------| | 短按 | 返回 | | 下滑 | 截屏 | | 上滑 | 快速 → 回桌面 / 慢速 → 最近任务 | | 左滑 / 右滑 | 切换上一个 / 下一个应用 | ## Requirements - Android 15+ (API 35+) - LSPosed or compatible Xposed framework - Root access - Scope: **System Framework** (`android`) ## License GNU General Public License v3.0
